strings.d1.s0.name: Meidan & Sioni Katedrali
strings.d1.s0.tips: The heart of the old city: St Nino's hanging cross and Shardeni Street.
strings.d1.s1.name: Narikala Fortress Cable Car
strings.d1.s1.tips: Take the cable car from Rike Park (Metromoney card). You'll find a 4th-century fortress, the Mother of Georgia statue and views over the Kura.
strings.d1.s2.name: Abanotubani Sulphur Baths
strings.d1.s2.tips: 17th-century brick-domed bathhouses (Pushkin bathed here too). A private room costs 50-100 GEL, scrub included. The Orbeliani facade is blue and looks like a mosque.
strings.d1.s3.name: Café Leila Old Town
strings.d1.s3.tips: Vegetarian Georgian food: try the pkhali and lobio. On King Erekle Street.
strings.d1.s4.name: Bridge of Peace & Rike Park
strings.d1.s4.tips: The glass bridge is lit up at night, over the Kura River.
strings.d1.b0.name: Shavi Lomi
strings.d1.b0.tips: An art-filled home restaurant serving modern Georgian cooking.
strings.d1.b1.name: Leghvtakhevi Waterfall
strings.d1.b1.tips: A waterfall behind the bathhouse district. Free; a good alternative to a garden.
strings.d2.s0.name: Rustaveli Avenue
strings.d2.s0.tips: Parliament, the Opera and the Rustaveli Theatre, in Soviet and art nouveau styles.
strings.d2.s1.name: Georgian National Museum
strings.d2.s1.tips: The Colchis gold treasure and the Museum of Soviet Occupation, plus the Dmanisi skulls (1.8 million years old).
strings.d2.s2.name: Dry Bridge Market
strings.d2.s2.tips: A flea market selling Soviet medals, glass, kilims and paintings. It runs every day and gets bigger at weekends.
strings.d2.s3.name: Barbarestan
strings.d2.s3.tips: Recipes from a 19th-century cookbook. Book ahead. On Aghmashenebeli Avenue.
strings.d2.s4.name: Vino Underground Natural Wine
strings.d2.s4.tips: A wine bar for kvevri (clay jar) amber wine, an 8,000-year-old tradition. Tastings available.
strings.d2.b0.name: Fabrika Tbilisi
strings.d2.b0.tips: A hipster courtyard in a former Soviet sewing factory, with graffiti and cafés.
strings.d2.b1.name: Sofia Melnikova's Fantastic Douqan
strings.d2.b1.tips: In the garden of the Writers' House; try the khachapuri (cheese-filled bread).
strings.d3.s0.name: Jvari Monastery
strings.d3.s0.tips: A 6th-century Holy Cross monastery with Lermontov's view of the meeting point of two rivers (Aragvi and Kura). 30 minutes by taxi or marshrutka (minibus).
strings.d3.s1.name: Svetitskhoveli Cathedral
strings.d3.s1.tips: An 11th-century UNESCO cathedral with the legend of Christ's robe and royal tombs. Head covering required.
strings.d3.s2.name: Salobie Bia Mtskheta
strings.d3.s2.tips: Lobio (bean stew) in a clay pot and mchadi (cornbread): a Mtskheta classic.
strings.d3.s3.name: Samtavro Monastery
strings.d3.s3.tips: St Nino's blackberry bush; home to nuns.
strings.d3.s4.name: Chronicle of Georgia
strings.d3.s4.tips: On the way back, see Tsereteli's giant stone monument, with views of the Tbilisi Sea.
strings.d3.b0.name: Shio-Mgvime Monastery
strings.d3.b0.tips: A 6th-century canyon monastery; an alternative to Samtavro.
strings.d3.b1.name: Chateau Mukhrani
strings.d3.b1.tips: Wine tasting and lunch at a princely château, 30 minutes from Mtskheta.
strings.d4.s0.name: Ananuri Fortress
strings.d4.s0.tips: On the Georgian Military Road (3 hours; tour about 80 GEL). A 17th-century fortress above the Zhinvali Reservoir.
strings.d4.s1.name: Gudauri Panorama Russia-Georgia Friendship Monument
strings.d4.s1.tips: A semicircle with Soviet mosaics at 2,400 m, with valley views and paragliding.
strings.d4.s2.name: Gergeti Trinity Church
strings.d4.s2.tips: A 14th-century church at 2,170 m, facing Mount Kazbek (5,047 m). Go by 4x4 (60 GEL) or on a 1.5-hour climb.
strings.d4.s3.name: Stepantsminda
strings.d4.s3.tips: Lunch on mountain khinkali (Mtiuluri, dumplings) in the town.
strings.d4.s4.name: Stepantsminda Kazbek View
strings.d4.s4.tips: The Rooms Hotel terrace. The return takes 3 hours, with a stop in Pasanauri.
strings.d4.b0.name: Truso Valley
strings.d4.b0.tips: Ghost villages with mineral springs; an extra walk (if you're not on a tour).
strings.d4.b1.name: Pasanauri
strings.d4.b1.tips: The town where khinkali was born; stop on the way back.
strings.d5.s0.name: Bodbe Monastery
strings.d5.s0.tips: 2 hours to Sighnaghi (tour about 100 GEL). St Nino's tomb, cypresses and the Alazani Valley.
strings.d5.s1.name: Sighnaghi
strings.d5.s1.tips: The walled 'city of love', with Caucasus views, a wedding registry office open 24 hours and a Pirosmani museum.
strings.d5.s2.name: Pheasant's Tears
strings.d5.s2.tips: Natural kvevri wines and lunch at John Wurdeman's vineyard, with tastings.
strings.d5.s3.name: Kindzmarauli Corporation
strings.d5.s3.tips: A kvevri wine factory in Kvareli. Tastings, and the semi-sweet red.
strings.d5.s4.name: Telavi & Alaverdi Monastery
strings.d5.s4.tips: The main town of Telavi and the 11th-century Alaverdi Cathedral (50 m high); then the return.
strings.d5.b0.name: Khareba Winery Tunnel
strings.d5.b0.tips: A 7 km wine tunnel inside the mountain, in Kvareli.
strings.d5.b1.name: Tsinandali Estate
strings.d5.b1.tips: A princely estate and garden; an alternative to Telavi.
strings.d6.s0.name: Sololaki Courtyards
strings.d6.s0.tips: Art nouveau entrances and wooden balconies; the Kalantarov house and the Betlemi stairs.
strings.d6.s1.name: Mother of Georgia
strings.d6.s1.tips: The aluminium mother on Sololaki hill, holding wine and a sword.
strings.d6.s2.name: Mtatsminda Funicular & Pantheon
strings.d6.s2.tips: Ride the funicular up to 770 m. See Griboyedov and the writers' pantheon, plus St David's Church.
strings.d6.s3.name: Funicular Restaurant Mtatsminda
strings.d6.s3.tips: Try the lobiani and Acharuli khachapuri (boat-shaped). City panorama and famous ponchiki (doughnuts).
strings.d6.s4.name: Vake Park & Turtle Lake
strings.d6.s4.tips: A park with a victory monument. Take the cable car to Turtle Lake and rent a boat on the lake.
strings.d6.b0.name: Open Air Museum of Ethnography
strings.d6.b0.tips: An open-air museum of Georgian houses beside Turtle Lake.
strings.d6.b1.name: Café Stamba
strings.d6.b1.tips: A stylish café in a Soviet printing house, in Vera.
strings.d7.theme: Dezerter Bazaar and a light farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Dezerter Bazaar
strings.d7.s0.tips: A huge local market by the railway station: churchkhela, suluguni, tkemali and spices.
strings.d7.s1.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral of Tbilisi
strings.d7.s1.tips: The Holy Trinity Cathedral (2004): 87 m tall, with a golden dome, on Avlabari hill.
strings.d7.s2.name: Machakhela Avlabari
strings.d7.s2.tips: An Adjarian khachapuri chain; a farewell meal.
strings.d7.s3.name: Airport Bus 337 Freedom Square
strings.d7.s3.tips: Bus 337 takes 40 minutes (Metromoney), or take a Bolt for 30 GEL. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Metekhi Church & Vakhtang Gorgasali
strings.d7.b0.tips: A church and a king's statue on a rock; an alternative to the cathedral.
strings.d7.b1.name: Puri Guliani Bakery
strings.d7.b1.tips: Bread from a tone (clay oven) and lobiani; street side.
strings.note0: A Metromoney card costs 2 GEL (metro, bus and cable car rides 1 GEL); Bolt taxis are cheap. Airport bus 337. For Kazbegi and Kakheti, take a tour (Gamarjoba, Budget Georgia about 80-100 GEL) or a marshrutka.
strings.note1: In summer the city reaches 30-35°C, while Kazbegi is cooler at 15-20°C and Gergeti can be foggy. Tbilisoba is in October, and Rtveli (grape harvest) is in September and October in Kakheti.
strings.note2: Turkish citizens enter with an ID card (1 year visa-free). Carry cash in GEL (ATMs), though cards are widely accepted. Khinkali costs 1 GEL each, khachapuri 12-18 GEL, a glass of wine 8 GEL and a bathhouse 50-100 GEL; tip 10%.
strings.note3: Call ahead to book a private bathhouse room (Chreli Abano). For Gergeti, haggle for a 4x4 in town. Sighnaghi is full at weekends.
strings.note4: Expect a supra (feast) and a tamada (toastmaster). 'Gaumarjos' means cheers. Hold khinkali by the top, sip the broth and leave the top.
strings.note5: Kvevri amber wine (UNESCO), chacha (grape brandy), churchkhela, tkemali plum sauce and pkhali.
